crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound…
In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day…
He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings, and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge…
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

translations.web: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
translations.bsb: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists.
translations.kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
translations.asv: He looseth the bond of kings, And he bindeth their loins with a girdle.
